newsitem.title: UK: Entergy in agreed London Electric bid.
newsitem.headline: Entergy in agreed London Electric bid.

text.p: Entergy Corporation of the U.S. on Wednesday said Entergy Power UK Plc had made an agreed bid for British regional electricity company London Electricity, valuing it at approximately 1.267 billion pounds ($2.11 billion).
The companies said in a joint statement that the offer valued each London Electricity share at 705 pence in cash.
In a statement the companies said London Electricity shareholders would retain the right to receive the interim dividend of 14.3 pence (net) proposed to be paid on January 31.

Including this, the offer "represents a premium of 27 percent over the London Electricity share price on October 23, the day before recent bid speculation in the utility sector led to a significant rise in (the company's) share price". London Electricity's shares closed at 683.5 pence on Wednesday.
The acquisition would provide Entergy with the basis for developing an expanded business in Britain as well as a platform for future expansion in Europe.

Sir Bob Reid, London Electricity's chairman, said the offer "represents fair value for London Electricity and is in the best interests of London Electricity shareholders, customers and employees". ($1=.6003 Pound)
